metadata.title: feat(teams): add team governance feature flags and enforcement ALLOW_TEAM_CREATION ALLOW_TEAM_JOIN_REQUESTS ALLOW_TEAM_INVITATIONS
metadata.author: crivetimihai

description:
## Summary

- Add three new feature flags (`ALLOW_TEAM_CREATION`, `ALLOW_TEAM_JOIN_REQUESTS`, `ALLOW_TEAM_INVITATIONS`) to control self-service team operations
- Wire three previously dead config settings (`MAX_TEAMS_PER_USER`, `REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_FOR_INVITES`, `PERSONAL_TEAM_PREFIX`)
- Fix `ensure_personal_team()` flag bypass bug — now respects `AUTO_CREATE_PERSONAL_TEAMS`
- Add `@require_permission("teams.join")` to three endpoints missing permission decorators
- Enforce `MAX_TEAMS_PER_USER` across all membership paths: create_team, add_member, accept_invitation, approve_join_request
- Enforce `REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_FOR_INVITES` at both invitation creation and acceptance time
- Admin users bypass `ALLOW_TEAM_CREATION` flag and `MAX_TEAMS_PER_USER` limit
- All defaults preserve current behavior (backward-compatible)

## Files changed (23)

| Area | Files |
|---|---|
| Config | `config.py` — 3 new flags |
| Services | `personal_team_service.py`, `team_management_service.py`, `team_invitation_service.py` |
| Routers | `routers/teams.py`, `admin.py` |
| Config propagation | `.env.example`, `docker-compose.yml`, `charts/mcp-stack/values.yaml`, `charts/mcp-stack/README.md` |
| Schemas | `docs/config.schema.json`, `docs/docs/config.schema.json` |
| Docs | `configuration.md`, `multitenancy.md`, `security-features.md`, `securing.md` |
| Tests | `test_team_governance_flags.py` (new, 13 tests), plus 6 existing test files updated |

## Integration tested

Container-level testing with flags disabled and enabled confirmed:
- `ALLOW_TEAM_CREATION=false` → non-admin 403, admin 201 (bypass)
- `ALLOW_TEAM_JOIN_REQUESTS=false` → 403 on both API and admin UI
- `ALLOW_TEAM_INVITATIONS=false` → 400 "Team invitations are currently disabled"
- `MAX_TEAMS_PER_USER=2` → 400 when user at limit, admin bypasses
- `REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_FOR_INVITES=true` → 400 for unverified invitee at create and accept time

Closes #3473

commits.message:
feat(teams): add team governance feature flags and enforcement

Add three new feature flags (allow_team_creation, allow_team_join_requests,
allow_team_invitations) to control self-service team operations. Wire three
previously dead config settings (max_teams_per_user,
require_email_verification_for_invites, personal_team_prefix).

Config & bug fixes:
- Add allow_team_creation, allow_team_join_requests, allow_team_invitations
  flags to config.py with backward-compatible defaults (all true)
- Fix ensure_personal_team() to respect auto_create_personal_teams flag
- Wire personal_team_prefix setting in personal team slug generation

Service-layer enforcement:
- Enforce max_teams_per_user in create_team, add_member_to_team,
  accept_invitation, and approve_join_request
- Enforce allow_team_invitations in create_invitation
- Enforce require_email_verification_for_invites at both invitation
  creation and acceptance time

Router-layer enforcement:
- Check allow_team_creation in API and admin UI (with admin bypass)
- Check allow_team_join_requests in API and admin UI join-request flows
- Add @require_permission("teams.join") to accept_invitation,
  request_to_join_team, and leave_team endpoints
- Add except HTTPException guard in create_team error handling

Config propagation:
- Update .env.example, docker-compose.yml, Helm values and README
- Regenerate config JSON schemas
- Update configuration, multitenancy, security-features, and securing docs

Closes #3473

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(teams): admin bypass for max_teams_per_user in team creation

Add skip_limits parameter to create_team() so admin users bypass
the max_teams_per_user limit. Discovered during container integration
testing: with MAX_TEAMS_PER_USER=2, admins with a personal team could
only create one additional team.

Also restores docker-compose.yml Team Governance block to commented
defaults after testing.

commits.message:
fix(teams): skip email verification for admin-created users

Admin-created users are implicitly verified since an admin vouched for
them. Only enforce require_email_verification_for_invites for
self-registered users (auth_provider == "local") at both invitation
creation and acceptance time. This prevents false rejections when
inviting users provisioned via admin API or SSO.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(auth): set email_verified_at for admin-created users

Admin-created users are implicitly email-verified since an admin
vouched for them. Set email_verified_at at creation time in the admin
user endpoint instead of checking auth_provider in the invitation
service (auth_provider is "local" for both self-registered and
admin-created users, making it unreliable for distinguishing them).

This fixes Playwright test failures where admin-created users were
rejected by require_email_verification_for_invites checks.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
refactor: replace while-True loop to fix vulture false positive

Restructure the stdio response polling loop in translate.py to use
`while remaining > 0` instead of `while True` with break. This makes
the post-loop return clearly reachable, fixing vulture's false positive
"unreachable code after while" at line 2098.

Behavior is identical: loop exits on timeout (break or condition) and
falls through to the 202 response.

commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
fix(teams): centralize email verification and return 403 for disabled invitations

- Move email_verified_at assignment into EmailAuthService.create_user()
  triggered by granted_by (admin-created users). This covers both the
  Admin API and Admin UI user creation paths consistently.
- Remove duplicate route-level logic from email_auth.py router.
- Add router-level 403 guard for ALLOW_TEAM_INVITATIONS=false in
  invite_team_member(), consistent with other governance flags.
- Add tests: admin-created vs self-registered verification behavior,
  invitation flag returns 403 at router level.

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
commits.author: Mihai Criveti

commits.message:
feat(auth): allow admins to set email verification status on users

Add email_verified field to AdminUserUpdateRequest so admins can
manually verify (or unverify) a user's email via API and Admin UI.
This provides a workaround when REQUIRE_EMAIL_VERIFICATION_FOR_INVITES
is enabled and a self-registered user cannot verify their email
(e.g., SMTP not configured).

Changes:
- Add email_verified to AdminUserUpdateRequest schema
- Add email_verified param to EmailAuthService.update_user()
- Pass through in both API and Admin UI update routes
- Add "Email Verified" checkbox to Admin UI user edit form
- Return 403 (not 400) when ALLOW_TEAM_INVITATIONS=false at router level

Signed-off-by: Mihai Criveti <crivetimihai@gmail.com>
